lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hey, Shin? I think your grandpa's here.

lines.speaker: Supreme Kai
lines.text: Um, excuse me, sir, who are you?

lines.speaker: Elder Kai
lines.text: What, are your eyeballs for show? Peep the suit, kiddo! I'm a Kaioshin!

lines.speaker: Supreme Kai
lines.text: And why were you in the Z Sword?

lines.speaker: Elder Kai
lines.text: Before I answer that, can anyone here pop my back?

lines.speaker: Elder Kai
lines.text: I spent 75 million years sealed away in that son of a bitch!

lines.speaker: Elder Kai
lines.text: All because of that bingus named Beerus!

lines.speaker: Elder Kai
lines.text: Wait a second, who are they?

lines.speaker: Supreme Kai
lines.text: Ah, them? They're from the mortal realm.

lines.speaker: Elder Kai
lines.text: Oh my! What are Mortys doing on our planet?
